'''November 2000 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin Sci-Fi Convention, Austin, TX on 11 November 2000. [[Jacob Mayer]] won it. It is known from Jeremy Losee's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1454">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-austin-sci-fi-con-11-nov-00d1454/ austin-sci-fi-con-11-nov-00], DeckTech (Jeremy "Degenx" Losee, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-austin-sci-fi-con-11-nov-00d1454/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Austin Sci-Fi Convention, Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jacob Mayer]]
